review_summary: Independent external JARVIS control review rejects the exact V01 Cross-Layer Continuity Audit candidate 6a9f3e21c631dd20a8a866391fa7cecb7d5ca4be6563fea9b347149c721b6f4e as a completion gate because it proves that the currently approved V01 render ancestry violates an absolute scene-continuity lock beginning at Layer 02. The GitHub Actions publication job checked the content-addressed candidate with sha256sum before copying that exact file into artifact 9363512906, and the published candidate, manifest and provenance all bind the same SHA-256. The audit records a best alignment of 0 px horizontal and +1 px vertical for Layer 02 against the exact approved Layer 01 parent, while zero shift is required. At zero shift, edge correlation is 0.650410; applying the +1 px vertical registration raises it to 0.766104. The Layer 01 to Layer 02 difference spans the full 1624 x 968 frame, 41.341207% of pixels change by more than 3 luminance levels, and 16.470466% become darker by more than 3 levels. Those broad negative and full-frame changes cannot be explained by adding the released wall-wash circuit. The same inherited 0,+1 coordinate drift is present when Layers 03, 04, 05, 06 and Final are anchored back to approved Layer 01. This violates the locked camera, crop, perspective, exact parent-coordinate continuity and previous-layer-freeze rules, which are independently disqualifying under the reviewer rubric. Immediate downstream parent-child additions remain internally consistent and the Final is byte-identical to Layer 06, but those facts do not cure the upstream Layer 02 ancestry defect. No approved master may be silently rewritten. Repair must start from the exact approved Layer 01 parent and every downstream cumulative layer must be independently re-approved before V01 can progress. Presentation generation remains locked.
